moments.title: Glasgow 2026 Commonwealth Games Conclude
moments.blurb: The 2026 Commonwealth Games in Glasgow wrapped up yesterday, August 2nd, with Team England finishing second in the medal table with 110 medals (29 gold, 45 silver, 36 bronze).

angles.name: Medal Haul
angles.copy: What a performance! Team England brought home 110 medals from Glasgow 2026. Who was your standout athlete from the Games?

angles.name: Games Wrap-up
angles.copy: The Commonwealth Games in Glasgow ended yesterday after 11 days of incredible sport. Congratulations to all the athletes!

moments.title: Official Singles Chart: Rein Me In holds #1
moments.blurb: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' continues its reign at the top of the Official Singles Chart (chart dated July 30 - August 5), becoming the longest-running UK Number 1 single of all time with 19 non-consecutive weeks.

angles.name: #1 Reign Continues
angles.copy: Still at Number 1! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' makes history, becoming the longest-running UK #1 single ever. Have you played it today?

angles.name: Chart History Made
angles.copy: 19 non-consecutive weeks at the top! 'Rein Me In' is officially a record-breaker. What's your favourite song from this week's chart?

moments.title: Ian Broudie (The Lightning Seeds) turns 68
moments.blurb: Ian Broudie, the frontman of The Lightning Seeds, celebrates his 68th birthday tomorrow, August 4th. The Liverpool musician is best known for hits like 'Three Lions' and 'Lucky You'.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Ian Broudie
angles.copy: Tomorrow, Ian Broudie of The Lightning Seeds turns 68! From 'Three Lions' to 'Lucky You', what's your favourite track?

angles.name: 90s Icon
angles.copy: The man behind some of the 90s' biggest indie-pop anthems. Wishing Ian Broudie a very happy 68th birthday for tomorrow!

moments.title: Paul Layton (The New Seekers) turns 79
moments.blurb: Paul Layton, bassist and vocalist for the iconic 70s group The New Seekers, will be celebrating his 79th birthday tomorrow, August 4th.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Paul Layton
angles.copy: Raising a glass to Paul Layton of The New Seekers, who turns 79 tomorrow! 'I'd Like to Teach the World to Sing' still sounds as good as ever.

moments.title: One-Day Cup season begins
moments.blurb: The One-Day Cup, England and Wales' domestic 50-over cricket competition, is set to begin its new season on Wednesday, August 5th.

angles.name: Cricket is back
angles.copy: The sound of leather on willow! The One-Day Cup season starts this Wednesday. Who are you backing for glory?

moments.title: Bruce Dickinson (Iron Maiden) turns 68
moments.blurb: Iron Maiden's legendary frontman, Bruce Dickinson, will celebrate his 68th birthday on August 7th. Known for his powerful vocals and energetic stage presence.

angles.name: Scream for me!
angles.copy: Up the Irons! Bruce Dickinson, the iconic voice of Iron Maiden, turns 68 on Friday. What's your all-time favourite Maiden track?

angles.name: Rock Legend
angles.copy: Not just a singer, but a pilot, author, and all-round legend. Happy 68th birthday to Bruce Dickinson this Friday!

moments.title: Jacquie O'Sullivan (Bananarama) turns 66
moments.blurb: Jacquie O'Sullivan, best known as a member of the iconic 80s pop group Bananarama, celebrates her 66th birthday on August 7th.

angles.name: Bananarama Birthday
angles.copy: Cruel Summer? Not for Jacquie O'Sullivan of Bananarama, who turns 66 this Friday! What's your go-to Bananarama hit?

moments.title: Ian Dench (EMF) turns 62
moments.blurb: Ian Dench, the songwriter and guitarist for 90s indie-dance band EMF, turns 62 on August 7th. EMF are famous for their hit 'Unbelievable'.

angles.name: EMF Guitarist Birthday
angles.copy: It's Unbelievable! Ian Dench of EMF celebrates his 62nd birthday on Friday. Still got 'that' song on repeat?

moments.title: Roots Picnic London makes international debut
moments.blurb: The iconic Roots Picnic festival makes its highly anticipated international debut at Crystal Palace Bowl, London, on August 8-9, bringing a blend of hip hop, music, and culture.

angles.name: Roots Picnic Hits London
angles.copy: Big news for music fans! The legendary Roots Picnic lands in London this weekend, August 8-9. Who are you hoping to catch?

angles.name: Crystal Palace Bowl Buzz
angles.copy: Crystal Palace Bowl is set to host the international debut of Roots Picnic this weekend! Get ready for two days of hip hop and culture.

moments.title: EFL season kicks off
moments.blurb: The English Football League (EFL) season, encompassing the Championship, League One, and League Two, officially begins on Monday, August 10th.

angles.name: Football is back!
angles.copy: Pre-season is OVER! The EFL season kicks off next Monday, August 10th. Who are you looking forward to seeing in action?

angles.name: Championship Hopes
angles.copy: From the Championship down to League Two, a new season of football starts next week. Any dark horses for promotion this year?

moments.title: European Athletics Championships in Birmingham
moments.blurb: Birmingham will host the European Athletics Championships for the first time ever, running from August 10th to 16th, featuring over 1,500 elite athletes.

angles.name: Athletics Comes to Birmingham
angles.copy: Get ready for track and field action! The European Athletics Championships arrive in Birmingham next Monday. Who are you cheering on?

angles.name: Birmingham Hosts History
angles.copy: A historic first for the UK! Birmingham welcomes the European Athletics Championships from August 10th. Expect some incredible performances.

moments.title: Feargal Sharkey (The Undertones) turns 68
moments.blurb: Feargal Sharkey, the distinctive vocalist of punk/new wave band The Undertones, will be 68 on August 13th, known for hits like 'Teenage Kicks'.

angles.name: Teenage Kicks & Birthday Wishes
angles.copy: He's got that voice! Feargal Sharkey of The Undertones turns 68 this Thursday. What's your favourite from the punk icon?

moments.title: Cliff Fish (Paper Lace) turns 77
moments.blurb: Cliff Fish, the bassist for 70s pop group Paper Lace, famous for 'Billy Don't Be a Hero', celebrates his 77th birthday on August 13th.

angles.name: 70s Pop Birthday
angles.copy: Don't be a hero, but do wish Cliff Fish of Paper Lace a happy 77th birthday this Thursday! Still love 'Billy Don't Be a Hero'?

moments.title: John Stokes (The Bachelors) turns 86
moments.blurb: John Stokes, bass player for the popular 60s Irish vocal group The Bachelors, will be celebrating his 86th birthday on August 13th.

angles.name: 60s Star Birthday
angles.copy: From 'Charmaine' to 'Diane', The Bachelors brought us so many classics. Wishing John Stokes a very happy 86th birthday this Thursday!

moments.title: Community Shield in Cardiff
moments.blurb: The traditional curtain-raiser for the English football season, the FA Community Shield, will take place at Cardiff's Principality Stadium on August 16th, featuring Premier League champions Arsenal against FA Cup holders Manchester City.

angles.name: Football Season Curtain-Raiser
angles.copy: Cardiff hosts the Community Shield! Arsenal vs Man City at Principality Stadium on August 16th. Who's lifting the first silverware?

angles.name: Wales Hosts Big Game
angles.copy: A huge game for Wales! The Community Shield comes to Principality Stadium next week as Arsenal take on Manchester City. Get ready for some top-tier football!

moments.title: Peak UK Summer Holidays Continue
moments.blurb: Schools across England and Wales are still enjoying their summer break, with most returning in early September, while Scottish schools typically resume in mid-August.

angles.name: Summer Holiday Vibes
angles.copy: Still soaking up the summer holidays across most of the UK! What have your best moments been so far?

angles.name: Back to School Countdown
angles.copy: For many, the summer holidays are still in full swing! But the countdown to back-to-school is on for some, especially in Scotland.
